approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lead: Weeks people have submitted. Approving a week locks its time and expenses so they can be invoiced.
approvals.offBodyAdmin: Turn on "Require weekly timesheet approval" in Account settings to have people submit each week for a manager to approve.
approvals.offBody: Time in this account doesn't need approval. An admin can turn it on in Account settings.

submitted.title: Nothing waiting for approval
submitted.body: When people submit their week, it shows up here for you to approve or return.

approved.title: No approved weeks yet
approved.body: Weeks you approve are listed here. Their time is locked until an admin reopens them.

rejected.title: No returned weeks
rejected.body: Weeks you return with a comment are listed here until the person submits them again.

approvals.partlyApproved: Approved the time on your projects. The rest waits for its project managers.
approvals.returnLead: {{name}} can then fix their time and submit the week again.
approvals.commentHint: Say what needs fixing. They get it by email.
approvals.reopenLead: Reopening unlocks this week's time and expenses so they can be changed and submitted again. Anything already invoiced stays locked.
approvals.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log with your name.
approvals.partial: You can approve the {{count}} of {{total}} entries on projects you manage. The rest waits for their project managers.
